description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 4.8.0 of the OrangeHRM system, responsible for inserting configuration data and creating a new internationalization group in the database. It includes methods to insert and update configuration entries and specifies the migration version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class for applying database schema/data changes specific to version 4.8.0 of OrangeHRM

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration actions: inserting configuration values and creating a new internationalization group

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Inserts a configuration key-value pair into the database

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration ('4.8')

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates the value of an existing configuration key in the database
